reviews.comment: Dr. Mortari is one of the top 5 Italian dudes of all time. Always telling random stories in lecture, super nice guy. This class certainly isn't the easiest but if you pay attention in lab and take a little time to understand the material it's not too bad.

Dr. Mortari is a really funny and charismatic person, but he could be a much, much better professor. Homework is very time consuming and 40% of your grade, remaining 60% is 3 non-cumulative exams. He's not good at preparing you for exams, only asks for questions on X topic and half solves examples without using any numbers. The TA carried the class
